record.question: The king _______ all opposition with an iron hand.
record.explanation: Answer A: bore down. “Bore down” is the option intended to mean overcame or suppressed opposition; the printed transitive construction is dated/elliptical. Reference: https://www.focail.ie/en/eid/down. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
